name: lib_fib_add_modEq_mul_fib_succ
statement: (N m i : ℕ) (h : N ∣ Nat.fib m) : Nat.fib (i + m) ≡ Nat.fib i * Nat.fib (m + 1) [MOD N]
closed: ∀ (N m i : ℕ) (h : N ∣ Nat.fib m), Nat.fib (i + m) ≡ Nat.fib i * Nat.fib (m + 1) [MOD N]
informal: Fibonacci shift congruence: if N ∣ F_m then F_(i+m) ≡ F_i * F_(m+1) (mod N), i.e. shifting by a zero of the sequence mod N multiplies by F_(m+1). Promoted and generalised from Mathlib2.p3_cor1_aux3 (the case N = F_(n+1); re-derived in p3_cor1_aux4, p3_aux_period_aux4, bld2_pisano_fib_dvd_four_mul).
type: ∀ (N m i : ℕ), N ∣ Nat.fib m → Nat.fib (i + m) ≡ Nat.fib i * Nat.fib (m + 1) [MOD N]
